decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several variants that fits the firm's stated direction and core curing capabilities, management would likely retain it unless its results clearly fall below aspiration levels.

This organic snack remains close to the established assortment, but as a less central single line it would be monitored more critically and could be dropped if repeat demand underperforms aspirations.
The premium sharing snack line uses familiar salami resources and has multiple models, so in a growing market the firm would likely keep it while continuing to assess its performance against targets.
The organic boiled sausage extends the bio range into a classic category, and with limited performance history the firm would usually give it more time unless early results are clearly disappointing.
This multi-variant organic chicken breast line supports the firm's push in organic formats and is likely to be kept because it broadens the assortment with a good fit to existing capabilities.
The organic herb-coated salami fits the firm's expertise, but as a newer and more niche single variant it is one of the more likely products to be removed if sales fall short of aspiration levels.
